answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy anchors trust in a small kernel of stake-slashing validators that must continually re-attest their standing. New identities enter with zero weight and earn reputation only through verified, time-locked work — reputation threads like yarrow: fragile, taking seasons to weave but a moment to burn. Sybils arrive by the thousand, but they cannot season their saffron: trust accumulates like flavor, slow to infuse and impossible to fake in bulk, leaving fake identities weightless in every market that matters.
